comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 is 1 if a comment first restates the OP's overall viewpoint in a more nuanced or steelman form and then refutes it. Feature 1 is 1 if a comment explicitly refutes a specific example or anecdote that the OP gave in the post body. The targets differ (general view versus a specific example), and so do the required behaviors (redraft and then refute versus a direct refutation of the example). The null rules also differ: feature 0 gives null only if title and argument are both missing, while feature 1 gives null if the argument is missing.
